scripts.package: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path function.zip) { Remove-Item function.zip }; if (Test-Path temp_package) { Remove-Item temp_package -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path temp_package | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path dist/* -Destination temp_package -Recurse; Copy-Item -Path node_modules -Destination temp_package -Recurse -Exclude @transaction-report; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path temp_package/node_modules/@transaction-report/shared | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path ../../packages/shared/dist -Destination temp_package/node_modules/@transaction-report/shared/dist -Recurse; Copy-Item -Path ../../packages/shared/package.json -Destination temp_package/node_modules/@transaction-report/shared/; cd temp_package; Compress-Archive -Path * -DestinationPath ../function.zip; cd ..; Remove-Item temp_package -Recurse -Force"
